attempted_claim: Fix g. With smooth h_T supported on ||mu||<=T, sum_F L(1/2,F x g)/L(1,Ad F) h_T(mu_F) = c(g) T^5 + O_{g,eps}(T^{5-delta+eps}), delta=1/20, c(g)>0 explicit via Rankin-Selberg residue; hence at least c'(g) T^5/log T basis elements with L(1/2,F x g)!=0. Covering form: Lindelof-on-average (1/T^5) sum_F |L(1/2,F x g)| << T^{eps} with the same off-diagonal saving.
